description: Run one round of daemon request admission: take procs_* letters from $AOS_STACK/requests/, apply the allowed names and max_running policy in JUDGE.json, forward admitted requests to the daemon's ctl mailbox and reply to refused requests with applied: false. Called by a daemon body or loop proc as aos-exec <judge folder> JUDGE.json with $AOS_STACK and $AOS_DAEMON; not a brain tool and does not take JSON arguments on stdin. Exit 0 after a round, including an empty inbox; errors go to stderr and exit 1.
